transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. _____. What brings you in today?

Um... hi. My manager told me I had to come in. I guess... I scared everyone at work. 

I wait tables, and... I don't know, I just started freezing up in the middle of service. Or doing things out of order. Like... they said I was just standing by the soda station holding the cash drawer key. Just... repeating table numbers over and over instead of closing out the checks. So... yeah. That's why.
Did this episode start right after a stressful or upsetting event?
Um... no. I don't think so. It was just... a regular shift. Nothing really happened.
During that episode, were you aware of what was happening around you?
Um... I don't really know. It's kind of... blurry. I guess not really.
At the time this was happening, did you hear voices or see things that other people didn’t?

Um... I'm not sure about right in that moment. But... I guess, sometimes. Not seeing things, but... 

Like, when I'm closing up, or... or just at home in the kitchen. I hear... a woman's voice. She just says my name, or... tells me I'm doing the count wrong. It's really clear. I usually answer her before I... before I realize nobody else heard it.
When you hear the woman’s voice, does it seem like it is coming from outside your head, as if someone else is in the room?
Yeah. Um... like I said, I answer her. So... yeah. It just sounds like she's right there in the room with me.
How long have you been hearing the woman’s voice?

Um... maybe about four months. That's when she got clearer, I guess. And... it's around the same time I realized what was going on at work. With the other servers and the customers... how they're targeting me. So, yeah... about four months.
Have you been using any alcohol, cannabis, stimulants, or other drugs around the time these symptoms started?
No. I don't... I don't use any of that. Just coffee, I guess. But no drugs or anything.
Have these experiences—like hearing the woman’s voice or feeling that people are targeting you—been going on continuously for at least six months?
Um... longer than that, I think. It's been... building for a while. Maybe... a year and two months? That's when I was asked to take on the evening shift lead... so, yeah. A while.
Have the voices or beliefs like people targeting you been present almost every day for at least one month?
Um... yeah. Every day. Like I said before... the voice getting clearer, and... being sure about everyone targeting me... that's been happening for about four months now. So... yes.
Have you had a period of at least several days when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable, with much more energy than usual?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really... felt like that. Just normal energy, I guess. So... no.
Since these symptoms started, have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt very depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I get tired sometimes, but... I haven't felt depressed like that. So... no.
Have you ever gone back to feeling completely like yourself, with your usual thinking and functioning, since these symptoms started?
Um... no. I don't think so. It's just... been like this. So... no.
Have other people told you that your speech has become hard to follow or disorganized?
Um... no. Nobody's really said that to me. I just... I think people understand me fine. So... no.
Have these symptoms been going on for six months or longer in total?
Um... yeah. Longer than that. I think... maybe about a year and two months. It's just sort of been building since... well, since they asked me to take on the evening shift lead. So... yes.
